comment: SOC v3 record-plane seed (dir_1790538151856). Applied idempotently by soc-indexer.js: chains INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (live DB rows win), then per-chain CHAIN.md manifest (if present) is file-first authoritative. All facts verified against disclosure-repo README/TIMELINE + pentest_findings + GitHub API on 2026-09-27. Component cvss null where no per-component score was ever published (legacy drops).

chains.name: Silent;Call
chains.summary: CUCM 15.x pre-authentication remote root — 3 HTTP requests, zero credentials. Spoofhack (unrestricted X-Forwarded-For trust) → Keyhack (hardcoded Tomcat Manager credentials) → Roothack (unrestricted sudo to root).

components.name: Spoofhack
components.role: entry — X-Forwarded-For header trust without restriction

components.name: Roothack
components.role: escalation — multiple unrestricted sudo paths to root

chains.name: Blind;Wire
chains.summary: Cisco Expressway X14.3.7 pre-authentication SIP request smuggling — ttclib_strToUInt Content-Length 2^32→0 integer wrap turns the edge proxy into a policy-blind tunnel. Confirmed live 2026-08-09/10; PSIRT + MITRE notified 2026-08-10.

components.name: Zerohack
components.role: Content-Length integer overflow (2^32 → 0) in SIP parser

chains.name: Dead;Dial
chains.summary: CUCM WebDialer pre-auth RCE via 2006-era Apache Axis AdminService arbitrary class deployment + JNDI injection. Independent path — survives Tomcat Manager credential rotation ( Silent;Call fix). Live-confirmed 2026-08-01.

components.name: Lookaphack
components.role: JNDI injection via deployed SOAP service → RCE

chains.name: False;Relay
chains.summary: MRA corridor chain (Expressway X15.5.1 + CUCM 15.0.1): presence-only edge gate (Blankhack) + zero-auth relay-credential seeding (Seedhack) + descriptor corridor + cluster-key identity forgery (Badgehack) = internet-origin pre-auth CUCM data (200 live UDS XML) and forged-Bearer SSO-session acceptance. Proven live end-to-end on both a seeded path and a pure-real-credential path (2026-09-27). Zero fail2ban ticks on the success path. Push held on lab-owner approval.

components.name: Badgehack
components.role: CUCM Bearer tokens validated by pure cluster-key crypto — no DB, no revocation, no throttle; forged sub → SSO session

components.name: Blankhack
components.role: Expressway-E presence-only X-Auth gate (ts_auth check-exist) — internet-facing box validates nothing

components.name: Seedhack
components.role: Expressway-C CDB loopback :4370 zero-auth → plant relay-credential row → attacker-chosen cookie validates

components.name: Splithack
components.role: chunk-extension request smuggling on shipped ATS rebuild (upstream fix e44213f8ec absent) — WAF/parser differential

components.name: Wraphack
components.cve: upstream class: ATS Content-Length int64 wrap (fix a9ec41a35)
components.role: CL=2^64 wraps to 0 — desync oracle + backend-leg smuggled-request delivery proven

components.name: Namehack
components.role: uint16 header-name truncation — 64KB alias traverses E→C→backend as short name; TrackingID correlation spoofing (strip defenses hold)
